nodes.name: actions.rs
nodes.summary: Implements WebDriver input action dispatch including pointer, key, wheel, and scroll actions following the W3C WebDriver specification. Contains the action state machine for computing tick durations, dispatching action sequences, and performing pointer moves and scrolls with viewport bounds checking.
nodes.languageNotes: Rust enums model action item types (Null, Key, Pointer, Wheel) with associated state tracking for pending scrolls and pointer moves.

nodes.name: capabilities.rs
nodes.summary: Defines Servo's browser capabilities for WebDriver, implementing the BrowserCapabilities trait with version info, platform detection, and WebAuthn extension support flags.

nodes.name: lib.rs
nodes.summary: Crate root for the WebDriver server containing the main Handler implementation with comprehensive WebDriver command handlers for navigation, elements, scripts, cookies, timeouts, and window management. Re-exports the start_server entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses crossbeam_channel for IPC with the embedder and warp for HTTP routing.

nodes.name: new

nodes.name: get_pointer_id

nodes.name: compute_tick_duration

nodes.name: dispatch_actions

nodes.name: process_pending_actions

nodes.name: dispatch_tick_actions

nodes.name: dispatch_scroll_action

nodes.name: perform_scroll
nodes.summary: Performs an animated scroll by dividing delta into steps at 16ms intervals, dispatching wheel events for each step.
